response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with 15+ years of software development experience and genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators). However, this is a Level II people-management role requiring at least 2 years of formal people management and 3 years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no engineering management experience — no direct reports, performance management, or organizational roadmap ownership. Mobile experience is limited to one iOS/Apple TV stint nearly a decade ago, and there is no evidence of leading organizational change at scale.
strengths: Extensive developer-tools and testing-infrastructure work (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium courses, CI/CD setup)
15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, and low-latency systems
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, dojos, and conference talks
concerns: No formal people-management experience (no direct reports, 1:1s, or performance management)
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience (iOS work ended in 2016)
No evidence of strategic roadmap ownership or leading organizational change in a large-org context

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure background
